title: Disabled lender's loan configuration can be used by a borrower
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as a borrower can use a disabled loan configuration but it will still work as a normal loan, so no lender value loss  **Likelihood:** High, as the disabling functionality can never work with the current code  ## Description  In the `LoanConfig` struct we have the `enabled` field, which is set to `true` for newly created loan config and can be set to `true/false` in `LoanConfigManager::updateLoanConfigEnabledStatus`.
